populationSource.note: Population re-resolved from current main after the handoff; the unrelated match-wide uniqueness commit did not alter CFB grading sources.

gradingSemantic: Current college-football defensive-back ability right now across corners and safeties: role-adjusted coverage, man/zone value, ball production without interception-only grading, tackling/run support, instincts, recovery, versatility, assignment reliability, explosive-play prevention, usage/responsibility and down-to-down consistency. No recruiting, draft-stock, fame, school-prestige or future-upside bonus.

currentSeasonWeighting.guidance: Approximately 55-60% 2026 performance/current role, 30-35% 2025 demonstrated level, remainder older/context. Judgment guidance only, never a literal formula.
currentSeasonWeighting.stabilizer: 2025 remains important enough to prevent short-sample overreaction in either direction.
currentSeasonWeighting.priorityRule: Audited roster priority is population/current-role context only and never mechanically sets the grade.

evidenceSnapshot.note: Evidence is frozen after the September 26-27 weekend so October 3 games do not create inconsistent timing within the position.
